I5.quote: Due to the suitable possibility of the hydrogen storage applications in the liquid organic hydrogen carriers (LOHCs), a systematic analysis of the chemisorption pathway of hydrogen on N–ethylcarbazole doped fullerene (NEC@C60) is given.
I5.location: main, PDF p. 2 (manuscript Page 1 of 29), Abstract

notes: Purely computational paper. Abstract (main, PDF p. 2): "we have investigated the nine steps of adding hydrogen onto the NEC@C60 using the B3LYP/6-31G (d) level of theory in the gas phase and decalin." Computational Details (main, PDF p. 7, manuscript p. 6): structures "were fully optimized in the gas phase using the hybrid density functional theory, B3LYP". The "experimental conditions" (150 C, 7 MPa) are conditions taken from cited hydrogenation studies (Sotoodeh et al., Eblagon et al.) and used as calculation inputs; no own experiment. The Conclusion's "gravimetric storage of NEC@C60 is about 1.5-2 wt%" (main, PDF p. 26) is not a measured uptake. Not a review; no retraction statement; is_retracted false. Page numbers are PDF pages (page 1 is the RSC Accepted Manuscript cover).
